The shape defeats per-transaction review because every individual leg looks ordinary; only the burst as a whole is anomalous. sar.narrative: Customer C03104, holder of card C03104-K1, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-11-13 and 2016-11-13, 4 transaction(s) totalling $799.73 were identified as unauthorised on that card, the earliest being transaction 3455750 and the transaction that triggered review being 3455821 for $199.95. The activity was conducted through the online channel in billing region 512.0. The transactions originated from device profile 'Trident/7.0 | Windows 10 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1680x1050', which the issuer's identity record marks 'Found' for this account. The activity matches no documented typology in the issuer's manual and is described in the accompanying case record. Closed investigation CC-3346 recorded confirmed fraud on comparable activity. The issuer assesses the probability of fraud at 0.94 on the evidence set out above. Total suspicious amount: $799.73.
